de: The Philippines moves its national calendar to align with other Asian countries' calendars by skipping Tuesday, December 31, 1844. The change has been ordered by Governor–General Narciso Claveria to reform the country's calendar so that it aligns with the rest of Asia. Its territory has been one day behind the rest of Asia for 323 years since the arrival of Ferdinand Magellan in the Philippines on March 16, 1521.

t: 印度和中国骑士的马斯克由詹姆斯六世和一世的侍从在汉普顿法院出演.
te: The Masque of Indian and China Knights is performed by courtiers of James VI and I at Hampton Court.
dz: 印度和中国骑士的马斯克由詹姆斯六世和一世的侍从在汉普顿法院出演.
de: The Masque of Indian and China Knights is performed by courtiers of James VI and I at Hampton Court.

t: 苏格兰承认 1 月 1 日而非 3 月 25 日为一年的开始。
te: Scotland recognises January 1 as the start of the year, instead of March 25.
dz: 苏格兰承认 1 月 1 日而非 3 月 25 日为一年的开始。
de: Scotland recognises January 1 as the start of the year, instead of March 25.

t: 克罗地亚贵族在克丁1527年的选举中选举斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王.
te: Croatian nobles elect Ferdinand I, Archduke of Austria as King of Croatia in the 1527 election in Cetin.
dz: 克罗地亚贵族在克丁1527年的选举中选举斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王.
de: Croatian nobles elect Ferdinand I, Archduke of Austria as King of Croatia in the 1527 election in Cetin.

t: 20岁的布列塔尼公爵弗朗西斯在岳父路易十二去世后继承了法国王位.
te: Twenty-year-old Francis, Duke of Brittany, succeeds to the French throne following the death of his father-in-law, Loui…
dz: 20岁的布列塔尼公爵弗朗西斯在岳父路易十二去世后继承了法国王位.
de: Twenty-year-old Francis, Duke of Brittany, succeeds to the French throne following the death of his father-in-law, Louis XII.

t: 现在的巴西里约热内卢位置是由葡萄牙人在佛罗伦萨探险家亚美利哥·韦斯普奇 (Amerigo Ve…
te: The present-day location of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is first explored by the Portuguese under their commissioned Floren…
dz: 现在的巴西里约热内卢位置是由葡萄牙人在佛罗伦萨探险家亚美利哥·韦斯普奇 (Amerigo Vespucci) 的委托下首次探索的。韦斯普奇开始怀疑欧洲和亚洲之间有一整片大陆。
de: The present-day location of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is first explored by the Portuguese under their commissioned Florentine explorer, Amerigo Vespucci. Vespucci begins his suspicion that there is a whole continent between Europe and Asia.

t: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世被加冕为匈牙利国王.
te: Albert II of Habsburg is crowned King of Hungary.
dz: 哈布斯堡的阿尔贝二世被加冕为匈牙利国王.
de: Albert II of Habsburg is crowned King of Hungary.

t: 迈克尔八世·帕拉伊奥洛戈斯被宣布为尼卡埃亚帝国同他的被监护人约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯(英语:Joh…
te: Michael VIII Palaiologos is proclaimed co-emperor of the Empire of Nicaea with his ward John IV Laskaris.
dz: 迈克尔八世·帕拉伊奥洛戈斯被宣布为尼卡埃亚帝国同他的被监护人约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯(英语:John IV Laskaris)同为共主.
de: Michael VIII Palaiologos is proclaimed co-emperor of the Empire of Nicaea with his ward John IV Laskaris.

t: 罗曼诺斯四世·迪奥根内斯与尤多基亚·马克伦博利蒂萨结婚并被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Romanos IV Diogenes marries Eudokia Makrembolitissa and is crowned Byzantine Emperor.
dz: 罗曼诺斯四世·迪奥根内斯与尤多基亚·马克伦博利蒂萨结婚并被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Romanos IV Diogenes marries Eudokia Makrembolitissa and is crowned Byzantine Emperor.

t: 据推测，匈牙利大公斯蒂芬一世被教皇西尔维斯特二世册立为匈牙利首位国王。
te: Grand Prince Stephen I of Hungary is named the first King of Hungary by Pope Sylvester II (probable).
dz: 据推测，匈牙利大公斯蒂芬一世被教皇西尔维斯特二世册立为匈牙利首位国王。
de: Grand Prince Stephen I of Hungary is named the first King of Hungary by Pope Sylvester II (probable).

t: 契丹建立的辽朝太宗攻占大梁，结束了后晋王朝的统治。
te: Emperor Taizong of the Khitan-led Liao dynasty captures Daliang, ending the dynasty and empire of the Later Jin.
dz: 契丹建立的辽朝太宗攻占大梁，结束了后晋王朝的统治。
de: Emperor Taizong of the Khitan-led Liao dynasty captures Daliang, ending the dynasty and empire of the Later Jin.

t: 皇帝霍诺利乌斯迫使加拉·普拉西迪亚与他出名的将领君士坦丁乌斯(英语:Magister mili…
te: Emperor Honorius forces Galla Placidia into marriage to Constantius, his famous general (magister militum) (probable).
dz: 皇帝霍诺利乌斯迫使加拉·普拉西迪亚与他出名的将领君士坦丁乌斯(英语:Magister militum)(可能)通婚.
de: Emperor Honorius forces Galla Placidia into marriage to Constantius, his famous general (magister militum) (probable).

t: 圣特莱马丘斯试图阻止一场在罗马的角斗士战,被人群用石头砸死. 此举令基督教皇帝霍诺利乌斯印象深…
te: Saint Telemachus tries to stop a gladiatorial fight in a Roman amphitheatre, and is stoned to death by the crowd. This …
dz: 圣特莱马丘斯试图阻止一场在罗马的角斗士战,被人群用石头砸死. 此举令基督教皇帝霍诺利乌斯印象深刻,他颁发了历史上禁止角斗士战斗的禁令.
de: Saint Telemachus tries to stop a gladiatorial fight in a Roman amphitheatre, and is stoned to death by the crowd. This act impresses the Christian Emperor Honorius, who issues a historic ban on gladiatorial fights.

t: 元老院违背他的意愿选择佩尔蒂纳克接替康莫德斯为罗马皇帝.
te: The Senate chooses Pertinax against his will to succeed Commodus as Roman emperor.
dz: 元老院违背他的意愿选择佩尔蒂纳克接替康莫德斯为罗马皇帝.
de: The Senate chooses Pertinax against his will to succeed Commodus as Roman emperor.

t: 罗马元老院追授朱利叶斯·凯撒为神。
te: The Roman Senate posthumously deifies Julius Caesar.
dz: 罗马元老院追授朱利叶斯·凯撒为神。
de: The Roman Senate posthumously deifies Julius Caesar.

t: 儒略历作为罗马共和国的民用历生效，将 1 月 1 日确定为新年的新日期。
te: The Julian calendar takes effect as the civil calendar of the Roman Republic, establishing January 1 as the new date of…
dz: 儒略历作为罗马共和国的民用历生效，将 1 月 1 日确定为新年的新日期。
de: The Julian calendar takes effect as the civil calendar of the Roman Republic, establishing January 1 as the new date of the new year.

t: 罗马执政官首次于1月1日开始为期一年的任期。
te: For the first time, Roman consuls begin their year in office on January 1.
dz: 罗马执政官首次于1月1日开始为期一年的任期。
de: For the first time, Roman consuls begin their year in office on January 1.
